out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: A plant was being watered in the basin of the hand sink in the kitchen
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. PIC MOVED THE PLANT OUT OF THE HAND SINK. HAND SINKS MUST REMAIN ACCESSIBLE AT ALL TIMES.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed a case of Raw shelled eggs being stored on the floor of the walk-in in the kitchen. Observed several cases of beverages being stored on the floor of the drink walk-in.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ELEVATE ALL FOOD AND BEVERAGES OFF OF THE FLOOR TO FACILITATE PROPER CLEANING.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Clean Utensils Storage and Handling
violations.observation: Observed water cups intended for self-service being displayed with lip-contact surface facing upward.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items and cleaned/sanitized utensils shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of food and lip contact surfaces are prevented. INVERT WATER CUPS.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Observed Raw shelled eggs and cooked potatoes being stored in the same container in the 3DR prep top cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE RAW SHELLED EGGS INTO A DIFFERENT CONTAINER AND PLACED IT ON THE BOTTOM SHELF.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed pickled vegetables and tuna salad being stored past its date marking in the walk-in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED THE FOOD.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Required & Posted
violations.observation: The food establishment's Permit to Operate is no longer valid due to expiration of the permit. No person shall operate a food establishment unless that person possesses a valid permit issued by the Health Department.
violations.corrective_action: To obtain a current Permit to Operate, contact the Health Department at (703) 246-2201 within 48 hours to make payment of the permit renewal fee. You may provide payment by cash, check, or credit card. Failure to pay the permit renewal fee and obtain a current Permit to Operate within 48 hours may lead to further enforcement actions by the Health Department including immediate closure. Facility renewed permit while inspector was on-site.
